_about: Hero creation: the most letters of the name. The choices of the look (gender, skin, face, hair, clothes) are in data/figures.json (hero).

jump._about: The jump of the hero (src/core/world/jump.js; docs/WORLD.md, 'The jump'). ages: the typical age of each grade (Pre-K is -1, K is 0). table: for each age, the median standing long jump (cm, the mean of boys and girls, so that a girl and a boy jump the same) and the median height (cm, the mean of boys and girls). Sources: the standing long jump of Polish children of 4 to 7 (Scientific Reports 2021, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-021-86903-x), of 10,302 European children of 6 to 9 (IDEFICS, https://www.nature.com/articles/ijo2014136), and the norms of 5 to 18 of Kolimechkov, Petrov and Alexandrova 2019 (https://zenodo.org/records/2546360, CC BY 4.0); the height for age of the WHO (https://www.who.int/tools/growth-reference-data-for-5to19-years/indicators/height-for-age, and the child growth standards for age 4). The values are rounded. The jump in blocks is (jump / height) x hero (the height of the hero in blocks, TALL.child of src/world/fine.js). run: the factor of a jump with a run. arc: the top of the arc is this part of the length (a throw at 45 degrees). time: the seconds in the air for each half block of the jump, and the least. hop: a small hop in place (seconds and the top in half blocks). low: the kinds of map objects that are low enough to jump over (a log).
